Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; GREEN HYDROGEN PROJECT. +]

[+Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $3,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the renewable development account in the special revenue fund under Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the city of St. Cloud for the Green Hydrogen Project to incorporate a battery and renewable energy system. bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to energy; appropriating money for the Green Hydrogen Project.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; GREEN HYDROGEN PROJECT.

Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $3,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the renewable development account in the special revenue fund under Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the city of St. Cloud for the Green Hydrogen Project to incorporate a battery and renewable energy system. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: Notwithstanding Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, paragraph (j), $3,500,000 in fiscal year 2026 is appropriated from the renewable development account in the special revenue fund under Minnesota Statutes, section 116C.779, subdivision 1, to the city of St. Cloud for the Green Hydrogen Project to incorporate a battery and renewable energy system. This is a onetime appropriation.
